_comment: Example settings file for Void-Tools. Copy this to settings.json and customize.

_notes.theme: Color theme for the interface. Use 'rainbow' for animated colors.
_notes.language: Interface language: 'fr' for French, 'en' for English.
_notes.skip_boot: Set to true to skip the boot animation on startup.
_notes.username: Display name shown in the interface.
_notes.setup_complete: Internal flag - do not edit manually.
